'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jared DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jared]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire|VB8-D-wookieeslavingoperation-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
